title: Sprite Library: 63 Pixel Art Sprite Packs (Characters, Monsters, VFX) + Every New One
short_text: 63 pixel art sprite packs in one download, every new pack added free
description:
63 CSAF sprite packs in one download, worth $478.37 bought one by one, with Godot 4 SpriteFrames in 52 packs and RPG Maker MZ sheets in 42, for $19.99.

Buy once, keep every pack that joins. The price rises as the library grows.

How the future packs work

  • Every new CSAF sprite pack is added here on its launch day. You do not pay again: the files appear in your itch.io library.
  • Every addition gets a devlog post here, so follow the page to hear about it.

Latest additions

  • 2026-11-13: Wildmark Actions 01 joins, repaired, with 456 PNG frames and sheets.
  • 2026-11-13: Wildmark 02 joins, repaired, with four more adventurers: 264 PNG frames and sheets at 128x128 and 64x64.
  • seven earlier additions, each with its own devlog post below.
  • 2026-11-06: the Library opens with 54 packs, 61,992 PNG frames and sheets.

What's inside (63 packs)

Wildmark: fantasy heroes, their action sets, held items and MZ battlers (10 packs, $76.90 one by one): Handheld 01 (new here first), Wildmark 01, Wildmark 02, Wildmark 03, Wildmark 04, Wildmark Actions 01, Wildmark Actions 02, Wildmark Actions 03, Wildmark Actions 04, Wildmark Battlers.

Hearthhands: villagers, townsfolk and their portraits (8 packs, $60.92 one by one): Hearthhands 01, Hearthhands 02, Hearthhands 03, Hearthhands 04, Hearthhands 05, Hearthhands Hallowtide, Hearthhands Portraits, Hearthhands Side.

Mourncrest: undead, grave goods and portraits (7 packs, $41.93 one by one): Mourncrest 02, Mourncrest 03, Mourncrest 04, Mourncrest 05, Mourncrest Portraits, Mourncrest Reforged 01, Mourncrest Reforged.

Kithfell: companions, pets, beasts and MZ battlers (6 packs, $46.94 one by one): Kithfell 01, Kithfell 02 Actions, Kithfell 02, Kithfell 03, Kithfell Companions, Kithfell Pet Shop.

Deepwarren: monsters with full combat sets and MZ battlers (4 packs, $33.96 one by one): Deepwarren 01, Deepwarren 02 (this page was its page), Deepwarren Battlers, Deepwarren Side.

Dreadmark: side-view bosses, eight states each, hit-flash and phase-2 sheets (1 pack, $14.99 one by one): Dreadmark (new here first).

Farmstead: livestock and farm animals (4 packs, $27.96 one by one): Farmstead 01 Actions, Farmstead 01, Farmstead 02, Farmstead 03.

Kept Year Faces: RPG dialogue portraits, five expressions each (1 pack, $7.99 one by one): Kept Year Faces (new here first).

Kept Year Cast: top-down field sprites of the same village, four facings (1 pack, $7.99 one by one): Kept Year Cast (new here first).

More casts: modern, cyberpunk, pirate, goblin, monster and creature-partner rosters (7 packs, $57.93 one by one): Bestiary, Brinemark, Greenskin 01, Neonward 01, Neonward, Pocketfolk 01, Streetlight 01.

Travel, wildlife and nature: travellers, carts and boats, birds, fish, trees and flora (6 packs, $46.94 one by one): Cart & Keel, Grovekeep 01, Skyfoundling 01, Tidewell 02 (new here first), Tidewell, Wayfarer 01.

VFX, ability icons and pixel fonts (8 packs, $53.92 one by one): Emberwrit 01, Emberwrit Skill Sets (new here first), Lantern & Tallow, Pixel Font Pairs Vol. 1 (new here first), Shroud & Sallow, Sigilcast 01, Sparkfall 01, Sparkfall 02.

What a pack contains

Every pack sits in its own folder exactly as its own page delivers it: PNG frames and sheets at their native grid sizes, its own Readme and its own licence. 52 packs carry Godot 4 SpriteFrames, 42 carry RPG Maker MZ sheets, 3 carry GameMaker files and three are pixel fonts with TrueType and BMFont files. Every pack works in any engine that reads PNG, including Unity and GameMaker.

Licence

You can use the sprites in commercial and personal games, with no royalty and no credit required, and edit them freely. You can't resell or share the sprites or fonts themselves as an asset pack, or use them to train a model. Each pack's own LICENSE.txt governs its folder.

The art in 57 of the 63 packs is generated with an AI pixel art model (PixelLab, on a paid plan that grants commercial use), then palette locked and checked by our own tooling. The three font packs, Emberwrit Skill Sets, Sparkfall 01 and Sparkfall 02 were drawn by code. The tooling was written with AI assistance.

Try before you buy

Free samplers from the same families: Mourncrest 00, Farmstead 00, Wildmark Sampler, Hearthhands Sampler, Kithfell Sampler, Deepwarren Sampler.

Questions or a pack you want next: post a comment below. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

$19.99 now. The price rises as the library grows: $24.99 for new buyers at 64 packs, $29.99 at 67. Buyers keep every pack.

Shipping on Steam? Steam's Content Survey asks you to describe content made with the help of AI tools that ships in your game, and the note above says how these sprites were made. A line you can adapt: "Some sprites in this game come from a third party asset library and were generated with an AI pixel art model or by code written with AI tools."

Made something with this? Post it below and we will add it to our Made With collection.

devlog.title: Sprite Library: Wildmark 02 and Wildmark Actions 01 join, repaired, 63 packs now
devlog.html:
Two Wildmark packs that were held back from the Library's first build are in it now, each the day its repair shipped. If you own the Sprite Library, download it again from your itch.io library: both are in wildmark-fantasy-heroes/.

  • Wildmark 02: The Second Rank: four more adventurers for the same company, 264 PNG frames and sheets at 128x128 and 64x64. It was held back because the forester's axe lost its haft in her north walk; version 1.4.0 repairs those frames.
  • Wildmark Actions 01: 204 Strike, Hurt and Death Frames: strike, hurt and death for the four Wildmark 01 heroes, 456 PNG frames and sheets at 128x128 and 64x64. It was held back because the rogue's side strike and the warrior's east hurt turned toward or away from the camera partway through; version 1.2.0 re-draws both.
  • The Library now holds 63 packs and 80,995 PNG frames and sheets, $478.37 if bought one by one, for $19.99.
  • The price rises as the library grows: $24.99 for new buyers at 64 packs, $29.99 at 67. Buyers keep every pack.

Questions, or a pack you want next: post a comment on the Library page. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

The art in both packs was generated with an AI pixel art model (PixelLab, paid plan), then palette locked and checked by our own tooling.
